Method of Attack: Stealing PIN codes via dynamic webinjects targeting Verizon Wireless, T-Mobile, and Sprint users
Injecting additional HTML and JavaScript code to add PIN code request forms on login pages
Capturing and exfiltrating username, password, and PIN to command and control (C2) servers
Using TrickBot as a malware dropper to infect machines with other malware families
Stealing banking info via proxy module
Access-as-a-Service enabling other actors to access infected networks
Impacted Systems: U.S. mobile carriers' users (Verizon Wireless, T-Mobile, Sprint)
Attack Vector: Dynamic webinjects proxying through C2 servers
Indicators of Compromise: IP addresses used by TrickBot variant as dynamic webinjects proxy C2 servers (available in Secureworks report)
